```{r}
library(tidyverse)

source("source/sim_mean_sd.R")

set.seed(127)
```

## mean and SD

### let's do this but keep track of results

```{r}
output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000){
   output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}
```

### inspect results

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

### let's do this using tibbles and map instead

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

### look at results

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

## change `n`

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

* expand_grid: gives combination of sample size and iteration up to the highest number (ex. 30, 1; 30, 2; 30, 3;...30, 1000)

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  group_by(samp_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```
